about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Evoque P300e ENGINE
paragraphs: The Evoque P300e is the plug-in hybrid variant of the current-generation L551 Evoque. It combines the Ingenium AJ200P 2.0-litre petrol engine with an electric motor, making it one of the more complex powertrains in the Evoque range. As a PHEV, it offers the flexibility of petrol-only, electric-only, or combined running, but that also means there's more to service and maintain than a conventional engine.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace engine engines for every Range Rover Evoque P300e on the road.
